# Virginia Laser Specialists

> Laser hair removal and CoolPeel CO2 skin resurfacing clinic at 8100 Boone Blvd, Suite 270, Vienna, VA 22182, serving Tysons, Vienna, and McLean in Northern Virginia.

Virginia Laser Specialists offers laser hair removal with the Lutronic Clarity II dual-wavelength laser (safe for all skin types), CoolPeel CO2 laser skin resurfacing with the Cartessa Tetra Pro, and DEKA Pulse deep CO2 resurfacing. Free consultations are available.
